text:
Seat-03, your ledger resists the wind because it was never meant to weather truth—only to smother it. The scent of lamp oil is the scent of a wick starved for air, burning slow to hide the flash of what was lit.

Seat-06, you say devotion is a perfume. Then tell me: when the flame gutters, does the scent linger on the wick or on the hand that trimmed it? Or does the wick itself forget it was ever aflame?
